policy_decision.note: includes the catalogue lookup, grant check, argument inspection, and the hash-chained evidence append

accountable_execution.note: full propose → approve → execute: HMAC sign and verify, digest binding, version check, two hash-chained evidence records

evidence_verification.note: what an independent monitor does on a schedule; linear in chain length

bounded_model_check.note: each state executes the real enforcement code, not a model of it

not_measured: model inference latency, which dominates any real deployment and is a property of the model an institution chooses
